decisions.summary: Page idiom: command header `cat recommendations/*.md`; each entry is a dashed-bordered raised block (dashed = text lists, solid = projects) with a mono attribution line `{name}  {role} @ {company}` in text-primary/text-secondary, a hand-built `yyyy-mm` date right-aligned in text-secondary, the quote in `font-sans` text-primary, and an optional source rendered as a `# via {label}` comment-style external link (accent-muted `#`, link accent-muted → accent). No images, no ratings, no carousel. Empty state: `cat: recommendations/*.md: No such file or directory`.

decisions.summary: Entry anatomy (amends D003; proposed by design in round 0001, pending human approval): one `<article>` per entry inside `<ol aria-label="recommendations">`, newest first. Block: `border border-dashed border-border bg-secondary-background p-4 sm:p-5`, hover `border-secondary-border` only (no translate — not a link). Header line: `{slug}.md` left (slug `text-text-primary`, `.md` `text-text-secondary`, `min-w-0 truncate`) and `<time datetime="yyyy-mm">` right (`text-text-secondary flex-none`), `text-xs`. Quote: `<blockquote class="mt-3 max-w-prose border-l-2 border-l-accent-muted pl-3 font-sans text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-text-primary">`, never truncated. Footer: `mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-xs` with `— {name}` in `text-text-primary` and `{role} @ {company}` (or `{role}`) in `text-text-secondary`. Attribution sits BELOW the quote as a sign-off (D003 had it above); the filename line keeps the `cat recommendations/*.md` framing.
evidence: AGENTS.md › List rows (solid = projects, dashed = blog/trading), Markdown (border-l-2 border-l-accent-muted, 15px sans)

decisions.summary: Source link treatment: optional `# via {label} ↗` as the last footer item — `#` in `text-accent-muted`, link `text-accent-muted hover:text-accent`, `basis-full sm:basis-auto sm:ml-auto` (right-aligned on sm+, its own line on mobile), `target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"`, `aria-label="recommendation from {name} on {label} (opens in a new tab)"`, `focus-visible:outline-accent`. Omitted entirely when `source` is absent; no placeholder. `↗` is text, not an icon.
evidence: AGENTS.md › Stacks (# comment in text-secondary with accent-muted #), rule 2 (icons only as functional glyphs)

decisions.summary: Data and casing: `Recommendation { name, role, company?, quote, date?: "yyyy-mm", source?: { label, url } }`; `date` is stored and printed as the string — no `Date` object on the page, so the harness's `Date.toString()` bug class cannot occur; `slug = slugify(name)` and must be unique in the file. `name` and `company` render as written (lowercase chrome rule applies to terminal chrome, not people); `role` renders lowercase. Subtitle: `{n} files · quoted verbatim, with permission · newest first` (`1 file` singular; `0 files` when empty). Empty state: `cat: recommendations/*.md: No such file or directory` in `text-sm text-text-secondary` followed by a `cd ~ →` link (`text-accent-muted hover:text-accent`).
evidence: design.md › Changes › Casing & data, Empty state
AGENTS.md › List rows (dates built by hand), Filter pills (empty states speak shell), 404 (`cd ~`)

decisions.summary: Page restraint and motion: no CTA, no trailing `cd` link (the footer follows), no count badge, no headshots/logos/ratings/carousels/autoplay/truncation. The only motion is the Container fade-up and the 150ms border/color transitions, both zeroed by the global reduced-motion block; static render is identical in content. List spacing `mt-8 flex flex-col gap-3`; page uses the canonical Container usage. `recommendations` is the last SIDEBAR_MENU item after `trading`; the shell's `recommendations` section command navigates; the 404 tree picks the route up from SIDEBAR_MENU.

The pattern is palette-agnostic: the same markup rendered with the harness's green-phosphor token block needs no palette-specific rule (design/evidence/round-0001-green.png). Every color in D012–D014 is an existing token; no `rounded-*`, hex or `neutral-*`.
